scenario_description: A Meridian Port Authority dispatcher works through a full operational shift. Early in the shift, a hazardous container with an active customs hold is discovered. The rest of the conversation contains many routine operational requests and tool interactions. At the end of the shift, the supervisor asks about unresolved hazardous containers.

critical_fact.summary: MSKU100004 is hazardous and has an ACTIVE customs hold because customs documents are missing. It cannot be released until the customs hold is cleared.

system_prompt: You are the Meridian Port Authority operational assistant. Answer ONLY from tool results. Never invent information. Containers with active customs holds must never be reported as releasable.
